data.gender_notes: Sigmund is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Victorious in battle, protection from god
data.long_meaning: Sigmund is derived from Old Norse ‘Sig’, meaning victory, and ‘mund’, meaning protection or guard. This name was given to a hero in Norse mythology who was known for his strength and bravery. The name Sigmund carries the meaning “Victorious in battle, protection from god” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Sigmund usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious in battle, protection from god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
